latHint: Think the way a bus or tram travels through town - not an actor's words.
pivHint: A LINE is what an actor speaks on stage - but a bus LINE runs along a what through town?
winText: On the right track. LINE was the pivot - an actor's words to a bus ROUTE.
lossText: ROUTE - a way from one place to another. LINE was the pivot: an actor's LINE to a bus LINE.
